title: Ikirego carumvikanye hejuru y'urusaku
intro: Urumva ijwi riduga rivuye mu kibano aho agahahazo kacitse akamenyero. Nta kwerekana ububasha kwishura iyo nkuru; ahubwo, ugusaba gushitse kuri Allah, kandi inyishu igatera mu mutima w’ugusenga ubwakwo. Ni nde yidoga, ni ikibazo ikihe cakurikiye, kandi ni ukuri ukuhe kwemejwe?
clues: Naciye ngira ubwoba kubera agahahazo k’abantu bari bakikuje.
Ivyo vyidodombo nabibwiye Allah ataco nshaka mu kwidodomba kwanje bwite.
Allah yumvise ikirego aca arishura n’ikibazo ku bijanye n’ivyo nemera.
Inyishu yabajije ingene noshobora kunanirwa kwemera Allah, we ari umwe kandi asumba vyose.
Naciye mbaza igituma Allah akwiye gukunda abantu bari abahakanyi.
Ndi Uzayiri, yitwa muri Sura Az-Zukhruf nk’uwo Allah yumvise ikirego ciwe.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Umugenzi yagenze mu bwato ku mwuzure munini .

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Kwidodomba kuri Allah ku bijanye n'agahahazo k'abantu .
Kugenda hejuru y'amazi mu gihe c'igihuhusi
Gutwara amabuye ku ruzi rwari rwabuze amazi .
Guca mu bwato buca mu mwuzure munini turi mu bwato .
trial.answer: Kwidodomba kuri Allah ku bijanye n'agahahazo k'abantu .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Allah yumvise ivyo kwidodomba maze yemeza Ubumwe bw'Imana n'Ubwami Busumbasumbane .
Kugenda neza ku mazi mu gihe c'igihuhusi
Kujabuka umwuzure munini ata nkomanzi uri mu bwato .
Kuronka ubutware buva mu Buseruko gushika mu Burengero .
outcome.answer: Allah yumvise ivyo kwidodomba maze yemeza Ubumwe bw'Imana n'Ubwami Busumbasumbane .

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
